description: Fetch the rebalancing trades the user decided on in the RetireCrunch Rebalancer, from the plan code they copied ("Send plan to my AI"). Codes work once, for 15 minutes. Returns the trades with IBKR contract ids where known. To act on them, create one IBKR order instruction per trade (create_order_instruction); the user reviews and submits each one inside IBKR. RetireCrunch never places orders.

code.description: The plan code the user copied from the RetireCrunch Rebalancer ("Send plan to my AI").

name: get_rebalance_plan
